domains.label: People & companies
domains.summary: Who exists, whom a team represents, and how relationships change.

domains.label: Music & catalog
domains.summary: Distinct creative works, recorded performances and release groupings.

domains.label: Rights & agreements
domains.summary: What is owned, earned, delegated, excluded or disputed.

domains.label: Assets & creative
domains.summary: Original media, versions, provenance, quality and durable deliverables.

domains.label: Sources & ingestion
domains.summary: Historic, incremental and corrective acquisition with accountable coverage.

domains.label: Knowledge & context
domains.summary: What the company knows, why it believes it, and what a task needs.

domains.label: Agents & execution
domains.summary: Bounded work, durable state, reusable procedure and traceable effects.

domains.label: Authority & security
domains.summary: Who can see, derive, export and act, under which constraints.

domains.label: Release operations
domains.summary: Prepare, send, observe and correct release delivery.

domains.label: Publishing & licensing
domains.summary: Works, parties, registrations and conflict resolution.

domains.label: Campaigns & audience
domains.summary: Creative activity, permissions, spend and observed responses.

domains.label: Income & accounting
domains.summary: Statements, entitlements, obligations, balances and cash.

domains.label: Analytics & intelligence
domains.summary: Trustworthy measures, forecasts, recommendations and explanations.

domains.label: Research & learning
domains.summary: Investigate questions, capture lessons and improve shared definitions.

domains.label: Company decisions & oversight
domains.summary: Who makes company decisions, how approval is recorded and how follow-through is tracked.

domains.label: Operations & reliability
domains.summary: Support customers, check outcomes and keep services running and recoverable.

nodes.label: Person or legal party
nodes.summary: Stable identity separate from user account, artistic role and software tenant.
rules: Do not merge parties by name alone.

nodes.label: Artist or creative act
nodes.summary: A creative identity can be a person, group or project; identify contracting parties separately.
rules: An act is not automatically a legal entity.

nodes.label: Music company
nodes.summary: Business subject with relationships, activities and represented parties.
rules: Researching a company does not create a workspace or access grant.

nodes.label: Identity role
nodes.summary: A party or creative identity can hold several professional roles; a role is distinct from a contribution to a specific work.
rules: Being a songwriter does not establish a credit or share in a particular work.

nodes.label: Roster & relationships
nodes.summary: Current and former company/creator business relationships, with effective history.
rules: Ending a roster relationship preserves identity and catalog history.

nodes.label: External identifiers
nodes.summary: Namespace-scoped, evidenced identifiers attached to parties or music subjects.
rules: Conflicting identifiers stay visible; external IDs do not replace internal identity.

nodes.label: Identity resolution
nodes.summary: Candidate matching, evidence review, negative links, merge and split history.
rules: Ambiguity is a result, not permission to invent a match.

nodes.label: Recording
nodes.summary: A fixed recorded performance with reusable identity across releases.
rules: An unreleased recording can exist before an ISRC.

nodes.label: Composition
nodes.summary: The musical work, distinct from each sound recording.
rules: Never infer a composition identity from ISRC alone.

nodes.label: Recording ↔ work link
nodes.summary: Evidence-backed many-to-many connection between recordings and compositions.
rules: Medleys, adaptations and disputed links need explicit handling.

nodes.label: Release & edition
nodes.summary: A listener-facing package/edition with territory and service variations.
rules: Release identity is distinct from a catalog and recording.

nodes.label: Release track slot
nodes.summary: Ordered recording appearance including disc/sequence and edition.
rules: Reuse recording context across single, album and compilation.

nodes.label: Catalog
nodes.summary: Business grouping of recordings or compositions with sourced membership.
rules: Membership grants neither rights nor software access.

nodes.label: Catalog membership
nodes.summary: Dated and sourced inclusion in a business catalog.
rules: Importing catalog repertoire must not enroll a creator in the roster.

nodes.label: Editions & derivatives
nodes.summary: Versions, stems, instrumentals, mixes, adaptations and sample relationships.
rules: Do not collapse a materially distinct recording into a duplicate.
Type recording-to-recording, composition-to-composition, asset-to-asset and sample/component links separately; no inherited clearance or assumed identifier equivalence.

nodes.label: Agreement & amendment
nodes.summary: Executed or draft legal instrument and versioned interpretation.
rules: A draft or extraction is not an approved legal interpretation.

nodes.label: Asset & use scope
nodes.summary: Explicit assets, rights, uses, territories, periods, conditions and exclusions.
rules: Changing catalog membership cannot silently expand an agreement.

nodes.label: Rights interest
nodes.summary: An ownership or licensed interest held by a person or company, defined by right, asset, use, territory and time period. Each interest retains its supporting evidence and conditions.
rules: Unknown shares are not zero or 100%; do not sum unlike bases.

nodes.label: Income entitlement
nodes.summary: Who benefits from a category of income under a scoped contract.
rules: Income entitlement does not by itself establish title or cash received.

nodes.label: Representation mandate
nodes.summary: What a party authorizes another party to do for a scoped operation.
rules: Business authority is distinct from application access.

nodes.label: Collection route
nodes.summary: Intended and observed payor/collector/payee routing over time.
rules: Submitted direction is not confirmed active routing or payment.

nodes.label: Reported claim & conflict
nodes.summary: Source assertion retained separately from reviewed rights, with resolution history.
rules: Conflicting assertions coexist until an authorized review resolves them.

nodes.label: License & clearance
nodes.summary: Use-specific permission and approvals across required rights.
rules: Availability of a file is not clearance to exploit it.

nodes.label: Media asset
nodes.summary: Audio, image, video, document or project binary with immutable content identity.
rules: A public-looking URL does not establish public usage rights.

nodes.label: Asset version
nodes.summary: Versioned edits, transcodes and derivations linked to original assets.
rules: Do not overwrite the only original or detach derivative provenance.

nodes.label: Asset manifest
nodes.summary: Queryable metadata and authorized pointer to object bytes.
rules: Object URL secrecy is not the authorization model.

nodes.label: Creative brief
nodes.summary: Task intent, reference context, constraints and allowed source material.
rules: Private reference media stays within permitted use.

nodes.label: Creative review
nodes.summary: Human quality and rights review of the exact output version.
rules: Rendering success does not prove creative or factual quality.

nodes.label: Approving & saving finished work
nodes.summary: Explicit transition from scratch/draft to a persistent reviewed artifact.
rules: Workspace existence is not durable product persistence.

nodes.label: Authorized object store
nodes.summary: Durable source/asset bytes with scoped access and retention.
rules: Do not use public storage for confidential originals.

nodes.label: Source connection & contract
nodes.summary: Authorized provider, scope, schema, terms, retention and freshness agreement.
rules: Source access is neither unlimited collection nor redistribution permission.

nodes.label: Raw snapshot
nodes.summary: Preserved original observation or exchange with provenance.
rules: A snapshot is an observation, not the whole historical truth.

nodes.label: Historical backfill
nodes.summary: Bounded, resumable acquisition of explicitly covered history.
rules: Partial downloads must not be reported as complete history.

nodes.label: Recurring ingestion
nodes.summary: Scheduled or event-triggered updates with durable watermarks.
rules: Advance cursor only after successful durable commit.

nodes.label: Staging & quarantine
nodes.summary: Parsed original values, typed candidates and rejected records.
rules: Reject ambiguous coercion and preserve recoverable source evidence.

nodes.label: Converting source data
nodes.summary: Explicit mappings of provider schemas and semantics to domain assertions.
rules: A renamed field is not necessarily the same metric.

nodes.label: Import progress & recovery
nodes.summary: Durable progress, idempotency and bounded recovery.
rules: Resuming must not duplicate facts or repeat external actions.

nodes.label: Quality & coverage
nodes.summary: Completeness, freshness, reconciliation and schema drift observations.
rules: Coverage and correctness are separate dimensions.

nodes.label: Source evidence
nodes.summary: A permitted source location/version supporting an assertion.
rules: Provenance follows information, not the requester.

nodes.label: Claim & assertion
nodes.summary: An explicit statement with supporting and contradicting evidence.
rules: Model output is not a verified fact by itself.

nodes.label: Source & transformation history
nodes.summary: Trace source → extraction → claim → transformation → output.
rules: Private-dependent derivations remain private.

nodes.label: Changes over time
nodes.summary: What was true and what was known at each time, with corrections.
rules: Do not replace historical beliefs with today's state.

nodes.label: Reusable public knowledge
nodes.summary: Independently sourced, eligible public facts reusable across Recoup.
rules: Private requests, research history and relationships are not published.

nodes.label: Workspace & guest context
nodes.summary: Private facts, relationships, plans and work scoped to authorized owner.
rules: Ambiguous provenance defaults to private pending review.

nodes.label: Context discovery
nodes.summary: Find all eligible context for selected subjects and purpose.
rules: The currently selected request is not all known context.

nodes.label: Purpose-specific context
nodes.summary: Cited, scoped facts and gaps assembled for the actual task.
rules: Explain omissions and recheck authorization before reuse.

nodes.label: Search & embeddings
nodes.summary: Rebuildable lexical/vector/graph retrieval indexes over authorized content.
rules: Index similarity is not evidence, identity or access authority.

nodes.label: Agent task
nodes.summary: Scoped user/business intent with success criteria and budget.
rules: A general objective is not unlimited delegated authority.

nodes.label: Skill & tool version
nodes.summary: Versioned reusable procedure and typed tool contract.
rules: Skills hold procedure, not hidden customer state.

nodes.label: Execution plan
nodes.summary: Inspectable steps and dependency/decision graph.
rules: Plan approval and execution success are separate states.

nodes.label: Durable workflow run
nodes.summary: Persisted run and step lifecycle independent of worker lifetime.
rules: A chat transcript is not durable orchestration state.

nodes.label: Ephemeral workspace
nodes.summary: Isolated per-run scratch files, drafts and intermediate code/media.
rules: Scratch files are not the canonical knowledge or rights store.

nodes.label: Tool action
nodes.summary: Typed operation bound to caller, target, constraints and input version.
rules: Recheck current authority at the point of side effect.

nodes.label: Approval record
nodes.summary: Specific human/system decision on a versioned action or artifact.
rules: An old or broad approval cannot authorize changed payloads.

nodes.label: Action receipt & reconciliation
nodes.summary: Request/response evidence plus observed downstream state.
rules: Accepted or submitted is not proof of the original outcome.

nodes.label: Checkpoint & handoff
nodes.summary: Portable run state for another stateless agent/engineer.
rules: Narrative alone cannot prove completed external work.

nodes.label: Authenticated account
nodes.summary: Software actor authenticated by an accepted credential.
rules: A business party and a login account are distinct.

nodes.label: Operating workspace
nodes.summary: Destination, authorized members, data boundary and billing scope.
rules: Subject relationships never implicitly provision a tenant.

nodes.label: Workspace membership
nodes.summary: Current software membership and role within an operating workspace; delegation is separately scoped and revocable.
rules: Historical business involvement does not establish current access.

nodes.label: Policy decision
nodes.summary: Evaluate actor, action, resource, purpose, time and constraints.
rules: Enforce before read, derivation, export and side effect.

nodes.label: Information classification
nodes.summary: Source/derivation visibility, sensitivity and permitted uses.
rules: Null owner is not proof of public provenance.

nodes.label: Audit & security telemetry
nodes.summary: Trace allowed/denied actions with minimal sensitive payload.
rules: Logs must not become an alternate private-data leak.

nodes.label: Connection & secrets vault
nodes.summary: Scoped credentials referenced by execution without exporting secrets.
rules: Never place bearer credentials in graph, prompts or research files.

nodes.label: Retention & revocation
nodes.summary: Deletion, expiry and access-change propagation through derivatives.
rules: Revocation must affect cached context and exported capability paths.

nodes.label: Release plan
nodes.summary: Coordinated release intent, dependencies and dates.
rules: A planned release date is not observed availability.

nodes.label: Metadata & asset quality checks
nodes.summary: Validate identity, credits, technical assets and delivery completeness.
rules: Syntactic validity does not prove partner acceptance.

nodes.label: Delivery package
nodes.summary: Versioned, approved release metadata and media for an authorized destination.
rules: Package must pin reviewed versions.
Component edits create a new package revision, hash and approval requirement.

nodes.label: Partner exchange
nodes.summary: Versioned inbound/outbound messages with profile and protocol.
rules: DDEX schema validity is not semantic conformance or delivery success.

nodes.label: Availability & correction
nodes.summary: Observed provider/DSP state, discrepancies, takedowns and repairs.
rules: Reconcile external state before reporting delivery complete.

nodes.label: Work registration
nodes.summary: Scoped submission of composition and party/share assertions.
rules: Credits alone do not authorize registration.

nodes.label: Repertoire matching
nodes.summary: Evidence-based match between internal and partner works/recordings.
rules: Retain unmatched and negative links.

nodes.label: Registration conflict
nodes.summary: Competing claims or discrepancies requiring review and correction.
rules: Conflict is not automatically a legal dispute.

nodes.label: Licensing workflow
nodes.summary: Use request, clearance, scoped terms and decision receipts.
rules: Control of a master does not establish control of composition.

nodes.label: Partner profile & standard
nodes.summary: Required schema/version/vocabulary/choreography and acceptance rules.
rules: One partner's acceptance is not universal interoperability.

nodes.label: Campaign
nodes.summary: Promotional objective, subject scope, activities and budget.
rules: A campaign is an operation, not music identity.

nodes.label: Audience & fan relationship
nodes.summary: Authorized audience records and aggregates with provenance.
rules: Access to a platform audience does not authorize unrestricted export.

nodes.label: Consent & suppression
nodes.summary: Purpose/channel-specific allowed contact and withdrawal.
rules: A purchased or inferred contact is not consent.

nodes.label: Content plan & publication
nodes.summary: Versioned creative outputs, calendar, approvals and channel receipts.
rules: Drafting is distinct from publishing.

nodes.label: Attribution & experiments
nodes.summary: Traceable measurement with definitions, confounders and uncertainty.
rules: Correlation does not prove incremental lift.

nodes.label: Royalty statement
nodes.summary: Source document/report and reporting scope, retained intact.
rules: A statement is a report, not cash received.

nodes.label: Usage & statement line
nodes.summary: Versioned reported activity/amount with identity and correction lineage.
rules: Preserve unmatched lines, original values and correction links.

nodes.label: Royalty calculation
nodes.summary: Reviewed contract interpretation applied to evidence-backed inputs.
rules: Generic JSON terms are not an implemented calculator.

nodes.label: Advances & recoupment
nodes.summary: Contract-specific balances, reserves, caps and cross-collateralization.
rules: Do not mix pools or apply undocumented recoupment rules.

nodes.label: Ledger & cash reconciliation
nodes.summary: Balanced accounting entries and reconciliation to reported/payable/received amounts.
rules: Expected revenue is not settled cash.

nodes.label: Payable & payout
nodes.summary: Approved obligation and controlled payment lifecycle.
rules: A route or entitlement does not authorize a payment.

nodes.label: Platform usage & billing
nodes.summary: Metered provider/tool usage, budgets and customer billing attribution.
rules: Provider cost, customer charge and music royalties are distinct.

nodes.label: Metric observation
nodes.summary: Source-defined value at a time or over a period.
rules: Never sum snapshots of cumulative counters as activity.

nodes.label: Metric definition
nodes.summary: Stable meaning, grain, unit and aggregation contract.
rules: Different providers' metrics are not automatically comparable.

nodes.label: Analytical projection
nodes.summary: Queryable curated facts derived from retained evidence.
rules: Projection is rebuildable, with lineage and tenant controls.

nodes.label: Forecast & valuation
nodes.summary: Assumptions, scenarios and uncertainty tied to dated evidence.
rules: Forecast is not an observed fact or financial guarantee.

nodes.label: Recommendation & evaluation
nodes.summary: Suggested action with reasons, constraints and measured outcome.
rules: A recommendation does not grant permission to execute.

nodes.label: Feature integration contract
nodes.summary: How a feature connects subjects, persistence, context, authority and outcomes.
rules: UI completion alone cannot establish a connected feature.

nodes.label: Decision & proposal log
nodes.summary: Dated decisions, alternatives, approvals and supersession.
rules: A proposal is not a roadmap commitment.

nodes.label: Architecture explorer
nodes.summary: Human and agent navigation over the same versioned graph.
rules: Visual structure does not implement data or security behavior.

nodes.label: Acceptance & verification
nodes.summary: Scenario-specific proof at exact code/data/environment revisions.
rules: Code-present, tested and live-verified remain separate.

nodes.label: Schema & contract registry
nodes.summary: Versioned domain/API/output definitions and compatibility rules.
rules: Do not equate a reference model with a deployable migration.

nodes.label: Change & drift review
nodes.summary: Detect source/model divergence and capture new requirements.
rules: Old source evidence remains dated, not silently current.

nodes.label: New learning intake
nodes.summary: Evidence-led customer problems and model improvement proposals.
rules: Client evidence stays in its authorized private home.

nodes.label: People, accounts & representation
nodes.summary: Sourced binding between a creative/researched identity, actual legal party, optional software account and represented workspace.
rules: No binding grants software access by itself.

nodes.label: Contribution & credit assertion
nodes.summary: Specific contributor, role and credited name on a particular work or recording, supported by source evidence.
rules: Credit is not a rights share or generic identity role.

nodes.label: Agent & service actor
nodes.summary: A non-human execution principal with identity and bounded delegated capability.
rules: A worker never inherits all of a human account capability by implication.

nodes.label: Delegation & client grant
nodes.summary: Revocable parent/child grant binding actor/client/run to actions, resources, purpose and limits.
rules: Child authority and budgets cannot exceed the parent grant.

nodes.label: Budget reservation & settlement
nodes.summary: Reserve permitted spend before execution, then settle actual cost and release unused holds.
rules: Retries must not charge twice; reservation does not change prices or authorize new spend.

nodes.label: Disclosure manifest
nodes.summary: Exact data and artifact versions to be shared with a named recipient or destination.
rules: Private-dependent output cannot be made public by relabeling its file.

nodes.label: Information an agent may use
nodes.summary: Selected subjects and permitted relationship neighborhood for a purpose-specific retrieval.
rules: Related subject identity does not expose another workspace research activity.

nodes.label: Fact checking & dispute resolution
nodes.summary: Review incoming claims against evidence, preserve disputes and accepted interpretation history.
rules: Receiving a claim is not confirmation that it is true.

nodes.label: Change event & projection checkpoint
nodes.summary: Reliable transactional change/outbox record and per-consumer checkpoint for graph, search and analytics.
rules: Handle duplicate, out-of-order and deletion events; external projections are not one atomic transaction.

nodes.label: Model & agent evaluation
nodes.summary: Versioned model, prompt/recipe, tool and skill evaluation against authorized representative cases.
rules: A fluent answer does not prove grounded retrieval or authorized execution.

nodes.label: Service health & recovery
nodes.summary: SLOs, queues, capacity, observability, incident response, backup and restore evidence.
rules: A configured backup is not a successful restore test.

nodes.label: Legal continuity & succession
nodes.summary: A sourced, reviewed relationship between predecessor and successor parties or legal capacities over an explicit scope; names and corporate affiliation alone never transfer rights.
rules: Do not infer support from this navigational placeholder.

nodes.label: Specialized rights & likeness
nodes.summary: A use-specific clearance case joining distinct source interests and permissions for samples, works, performances, adaptations, likeness and synthetic media; no blanket cleared flag.
rules: Do not infer support from this navigational placeholder.

nodes.label: Sessions, stems & quality checks
nodes.summary: A production revision dossier groups exact session assets, contributors and technical checks without treating source audio as the approved delivery master.
rules: Do not infer support from this navigational placeholder.

nodes.label: Currency, taxes & accounting close
nodes.summary: Connect statements, cash, ledger entries, currency conversions and tax or withholding records for a defined accounting period.
rules: Do not infer support from this navigational placeholder.

nodes.label: Customer & service operations
nodes.summary: A service-case record links customer commitments and product entitlement to the correct billing account and represented parties without treating subscription payment as business authority.
rules: Do not infer support from this navigational placeholder.

nodes.label: Audience privacy operations
nodes.summary: An audience data operation binds purpose, identity scope, grants, retention and observed execution while distinguishing workspace contacts from marketing permission.
rules: Do not infer support from this navigational placeholder.

nodes.label: Live, touring & commerce
nodes.summary: A bounded live or commerce case links engagement, supplier/source, inventory or ticket evidence and settlement without assuming a built-in tour or commerce platform.
rules: Do not infer support from this navigational placeholder.

nodes.label: A&R & artist development
nodes.summary: A private development opportunity joins evidence, creative goals and scoped investment decisions while preserving the distinction between research, deal negotiation and active roster relationship.
rules: Do not infer support from this navigational placeholder.

nodes.label: Recovery & continuity drills
nodes.summary: A designed or executed recovery exercise records the exact scope, source state, restoration/replay evidence and measurable outcome without inferring recovery from retries alone.
rules: Do not infer support from this navigational placeholder.

nodes.label: Guest session identity
nodes.summary: Opaque temporary principal for guest-owned context, requests and scratch work, with expiry and explicit later attachment. It is distinct from an authenticated account and a software workspace.
rules: Private guest work remains session-owned until an explicit verified attachment to an authenticated owner.
Guest identity does not grant workspace membership, business mandates, publication rights or collection authority.
Expiry invalidates retrieval and derived caches under retention policy; never reuse an expired owner ID.

nodes.label: Public reuse and private derivation
nodes.summary: public-source facts may compound; private or ambiguous evidence, customer activity and private-derived results stay private.

nodes.label: Business mandate and scoped authority
nodes.summary: Separate represented-party authority from software access, rights, income entitlements and collection routes. Unknown territory, period or exclusions cannot imply broad permission.

nodes.label: Approval and disclosure ledger
nodes.summary: durable approvals bind exact proposal/content/resource versions, recipient, purpose, budget and expiry; read permission alone never grants export or publish.

nodes.label: Shared permission rules
nodes.summary: shared decision combines actor, workspace, resource, action, purpose, time, delegation, mandate, approval and budget; domain operations enforce it across all transports.

nodes.label: Official records & working files
nodes.summary: Product database owns accepted operational state; evidence storage owns originals; skills own reusable instructions; scoped agent files own drafts and resumable work. Promotion is explicit.

nodes.label: Repeatable agent test case
nodes.summary: Versioned input, expected behavior, safe environment fixture and source lineage for reproducing an agent success or failure.
rules: Versioned scoped definition; evaluation quality is separate from action authority and external outcome.

Freeze grouped membership and versioned rubric/fixtures. Reusing held-out scores to choose patches consumes their independence; retain a further locked confirmation set. Accept multiple valid action paths and evaluate required final state.

nodes.label: Replaceable agent grader
nodes.summary: Versioned deterministic, reference, rubric, trajectory or human check with calibration evidence and explicit failure handling.
rules: Versioned scoped definition; evaluation quality is separate from action authority and external outcome.

Validate subjective judgments against attributed reserved labels before their intended use. Preserve both error classes, applicability/unknowns, denominators and legitimate disagreement. Same-model or different-model judging alone establishes no reliability. Revalidate on material changes; no universal numeric threshold or reviewer requirement.

nodes.label: Model call & token usage
nodes.summary: One actual model request attempt: exact provider/model/configuration, usage, cost, timing and outcome, linked to its owning agent run.
rules: Every model attempt has durable identity and run ancestry; unavailable counters are unknown, not zero.
Costs and token totals preserve provider accounting semantics and never double count child runs or cached/reasoning subsets.

nodes.label: Persistent agent workspace
nodes.summary: Persistent agent working environment for ongoing goals, files, skills, private tools/databases and resume state.
rules: Platform owns authority/lifecycle, the agent owns mutable working methods, and product services own accepted business meaning. Editing a file or local database never grants permissions. Independent workspace goals are allowed within company context/authority; register scoped tasks when shared scheduling/reporting depends on them.
Persist selected progress/context/artifacts independently of replaceable runtime. Restore files and leases separately; reconcile prior external actions rather than infer completion from a snapshot.

Use a coordinated writer or isolated copies with revision reconciliation; never silently overwrite another agent’s work. Versioned platform defaults and agent/user customization have separate update ownership.

nodes.label: Agent reporting preferences
nodes.summary: Modular company/user reporting choices combining summaries, meaningful events, output kind, priority and preferred channels.
rules: Support summaries and important-event alerts. Choose recipients and channels using the output type, priority and company rules. Companies must define which preferences take precedence.

A saved preference or artifact is not delivered, read or accepted. Preserve exact content/version, recipient, scoped destination, channel capability and receipts. Unavailable or uncertain delivery stays visible; fallback is explicit and retries reconcile prior effects.

nodes.label: Creative attempt & outcome
nodes.summary: One independently decidable pitch or activation, with accountable owner, occurrence evidence and a preserved outcome.
rules: Retain repeated declined pitches and failed activations as separate attempts. A pitch can occur without exposure; an agreement can succeed before launch. Never-launched means no public exposure, not no work.

Company settings may authorize human or agent initiation/acceptance. Suggestion generation alone is not an operational commitment; current mode/access/budget and business evidence still govern execution.

nodes.label: Creative assessment & evidence
nodes.summary: A versioned answer about commercial results, incremental effect, future scenarios or next opportunities; these meanings remain distinct.
rules: Commercial facts remain at their basis, currency, asset and period. Contract, invoice, earned amount, settlement and cash are stages of one chain, not additive revenue. Administration income does not require copyright ownership.

A failed causal gate returns inconclusive without hiding a valid license or an unpriced recommendation. Signed outcomes, costs, control quality, date uncertainty, temporal leakage and overlap remain visible.

Current grants/revocation, input identity and worker generation are rechecked before qualification/publication. Acquisition scenarios create a research annex by default, not writes to an investment model.

nodes.label: What an agent can actually do
nodes.summary: A scoped record comparing a capability claim with configured tools, permitted reads/writes and demonstrated operator behavior.
rules: Compare application support, actual connector reach, current grants and observed behavior independently. A visible Accounting module and no agent financial connector are compatible facts. Selected label filters are not proof of enforced access.
Saved-thread recall, fresh-chat recall, workspace context, durable artifacts and semantic retrieval are separate tests. A single failed recall does not establish absent memory infrastructure.

nodes.label: Exchange rule & validation requirement
nodes.summary: A versioned normative, profile or bilateral rule with exact source and separately recorded validation evidence.
rules: Preserve grammar, profile, reference-integrity, arithmetic, choreography and bilateral acceptance as separate check layers. Compilation or vocabulary membership does not establish truth or recipient acceptance.
Normative requirements, informative examples, historical guides and local interpretations retain different authority. Missing definitions and source conflicts cannot be silently filled.

nodes.label: Connecting standard fields to company data
nodes.summary: A mapping decision from an exact source path and structural context to an internal meaning; source fields remain inspectable independently.
rules: XML local cardinality, optional/repeating parents, choices, groups and inherited types remain intact. JSON required/null/alternatives and flat-file positional/block rules are not interchangeable.

A source definition or similarly named field is not a production mapping. Record preserved, transformed, unresolved, intentionally unsupported or rejected outcomes and reversible round-trip/loss evidence.

nodes.label: Versioned distribution deal set
nodes.summary: The exact full or partial availability terms communicated for a release under a pinned message lifecycle, distinct from owned rights and actual store availability.
rules: Under the ERN 4.3.2 common rules, new release-message deals replace existing deals effective at MessageCreatedDate. Retain every still-valid deal in the replacement; omission may withdraw a current permission.

Future reductions require the selected version’s end-dated terms. Empty deals, pre-release takedown and purge differ; a purge also needs evidenced requester authority. Unknown prior deals block an unsafe full-replacement interpretation, not unrelated work.

nodes.label: Recording production session
nodes.summary: A sourced creative session relating participants, components, equipment/processes and files; distinct from a released recording edition.
rules: Preserve sessions, contributors, activities, components, files and technical settings at their actual scope. Do not turn every production component into a new distributed recording or infer legal shares from credits.
RIN source structure and selected profile/version remain pinned; missing contribution or file metadata stays unknown and does not authorize fabricated credits or asset access.

nodes.label: Contributor identity-cluster view
nodes.summary: A source- and purpose-specific cluster assertion about works or duplicate recording identifiers; it does not merge identities by itself.
rules: ECM represents a contributor’s view at a version and purpose. Different sources may disagree; keep cluster members, exclusions, amendments, withdrawal and sender/origin separate from a canonical identity decision.
A duplicate ISRC cluster or negative LRAW link is evidence for review, not an automatic identity/rights merge. Current authorization and original scope govern all derived uses.

nodes.label: Release delivery
nodes.summary: Release/resource/party/cue/chapter metadata, technical editions and version-specific deals; full deal-set replacement, future/current reductions, pre-orders, takedown and purge.
rules: Prepare the complete selected release and deals; validate metadata/resources/profile; send an authorized exact package; reconcile acceptance and actual availability.
Treat a full replacement as a rights-reduction risk; recover supported full terms before sending. Future reductions carry selected-version end dates.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Music descriptions & enrichment
nodes.summary: Source-attributed content enrichment: descriptive/context metadata, origin/trust and separately identified parties.
rules: Receive attributed enrichment; preserve origin and version; check references/trust; qualify context without converting description into ownership.
Retain origin and uncertainty; do not promote sender identity into verified truth.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.
nodes.technicalLabel: DDEX MEAD — Media Enrichment and Description

nodes.label: Artist & contributor information
nodes.summary: Party identity, names, enrichment and requests; distinguish party from credited name and message-local reference.
rules: Receive or request party enrichment; preserve identifiers/names/source; evaluate ambiguity; publish a scoped assertion or explicit unresolved match.
Preserve both candidates and provenance; do not name-only merge.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.
nodes.technicalLabel: DDEX PIE — Party Identification and Enrichment

nodes.label: Catalog transfers
nodes.summary: Three-party controller reassignment and confirmation; broader best practices cover distributor-involved transfers outside the narrow CT standard.
rules: Resolve relinquishing/acquiring controller and DSP scope; conduct main/confirmation exchanges; reconcile affected resources, identifiers and availability; record continuity.
Use the applicable broader procedure and preserve unknowns; CT receipt alone does not prove legal acquisition, payout setup or uninterrupted store availability.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Recording session information
nodes.summary: Production sessions, activities, contributors, components and files retain technical/creative history separate from release editions.
rules: Collect sourced session/contribution/component/file data; preserve scope and roles; validate selected RIN dependencies; connect qualified recording/asset histories.
Keep components and recordings distinct; preserve unknown credits and broken dependency diagnostics.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Sales & usage reporting
nodes.summary: Exchange sales, usage, revenue and control totals by period and territory, with versioned reporting formats and corrections.
rules: Pin architecture/profile/variant/records/AVS; acquire complete report batch; parse original positions and reconcile controls; publish supported units/amounts and correction lineage.
Require actual header/summary/footer and negotiated no-activity scope; preserve missing/incomplete partitions and replace only exact supported coverage.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Work claims & discrepancies
nodes.summary: Six-part claim/detail/discrepancy/overclaim/correction suite: claims and responses are evidence, not royalty cash or adjudicated ownership.
rules: Link exact report/work/right/share scopes; exchange claim statements; retain data/overclaim discrepancies; reconcile corrective claims and recipient outcomes.
Keep claimants and scope distinct; open review/response rather than silently rescaling ownership or paying inferred balances.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Work ownership-share notifications
nodes.summary: Notifications, requests and recalls with profile-bound share basis, work part, territory/use/DSP/carrier/model exclusions, period and prior-royalty/payable qualifiers.
rules: Qualify work/party/share/mandate evidence; prepare selected notifications/requests; validate profile/references; reconcile response/recall and scoped claims.
Preserve distinct share bases, unknown/not-claimed/disputed states and original authorizations.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: US musical-work licensing
nodes.summary: US-specific musical-work licence requests, licences and revocation choreography; preserve jurisdiction and version-specific participants.
rules: Prepare authorized work/use/territory requests; follow the selected US choreography; retain licence/revocation terms and exact evidence; reconcile downstream licensed use.
Honor only supported licence scope and current mandates; retain pending/rejected/revoked states.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: US collection instructions
nodes.summary: US-specific direction/confirmation changes representation or collection routing; identity, legal mandate and payment redirection require separate evidence.
rules: Verify direction and affected routing; send exact message; collect counterpart confirmation; update only accepted future/effective scope with history preserved.
Keep ownership, mandate, collection and payment-change authorization separate; no implicit access grants.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Bulk work & recording metadata
nodes.summary: Related bulk work/recording/share files, positional definitions, cross-file links and completeness; not generic unversioned CSV.
rules: Acquire permitted whole related-file batch; parse exact positions/profiles; reconcile cross-file reference/completeness; qualify linked repertoire assertions.
Retain batch incompleteness and original rows; no fabricated identity or share defaults.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.
nodes.technicalLabel: DDEX BWARM — Bulk Communication of Work and Recording Metadata

nodes.label: Recording rights & revenue exchange
nodes.summary: RDR-C protocol, RDR-N recording/claim/contributor/mandate messages, RDR-R revenue and RDR-RCC narrow overclaim responses remain distinct.
rules: Acquire and send exact repertoire/claim/mandate/revenue messages; inspect producer/performer/territory scopes; respond pending/maintain/update/revoke to conflicts; reconcile accepted assertions and reported revenue.
Record an explicit pending response and required follow-up; avoid conflating historic MLC naming with The Mechanical Licensing Collective.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Recording-to-composition links
nodes.summary: Positive and negative links/requests retain optional music identifiers, source purposes and unresolved identity.
rules: Acquire sourced positive/negative linking assertion; preserve identifiers and purpose; compare competing evidence; publish a reviewed link or explicit unresolved/negative assertion.
Preserve the original negative evidence and versioned review; no global entity deletion.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.
nodes.technicalLabel: DDEX LRAW — Links between Resources and Musical Works

nodes.label: Related works & recording identifiers
nodes.summary: Contributor-specific musical-work and duplicate-ISRC cluster views with JSON/dialect/dependency context; cluster membership is not canonical identity.
rules: Receive a dated source/purpose cluster view; parse exact JSON and dependencies; evaluate contradictions; qualify a scoped view without automatic merge.
Preserve syntax/meta-schema failure and the affected source view; do not patch or invent canonical agreement.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Unusual listening activity
nodes.summary: Consumer-engagement anomaly notifications and responses preserve evidence and resolution scope; observed anomaly is not proven fraud.
rules: Capture permitted anomaly evidence at metric/time/source grain; use exact JSON/protocol; investigate and exchange scoped response; retain resolution or unknown cause.
Keep observation, interpretation and accepted decision separate; apply company task modes and affected-only rules.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Music NFTs & metadata
nodes.summary: Specialized defined music NFT exchange; token/product metadata does not by itself convey music copyright, consent or financial entitlement.
rules: Select supplied specialized exchange and permitted use; qualify metadata/asset/rights evidence; validate exact contract; retain authorized exchange and independently supported entitlement.
Keep token metadata and explicit licensed rights/terms distinct; broader Web3 architecture is not inferred.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Music data exchange standards
nodes.summary: Independent AVS, dictionary and DPID standards/governance, source licensing and supporting dependencies determine terminology and exchange identity without agent access authority.
rules: Preserve exact published artifacts and vocabulary editions; qualify relevant organization/partner conditions; resolve imports and identity representation; approve only evidenced compatibility and current actor access.
Keep old bytes/meaning, licensing unknowns and actual membership/delegation separately.
Standards reference/workflow lens only; this node is not a new application table or proof of supported exchange.

nodes.label: Evaluation review observation
nodes.summary: Selected trace, review progress, attributed judgment and sampling basis; a selected record is not automatically reviewed.
rules: Reviewed requires exact trace/criteria, authorized reviewer, timestamp and evidence critique; selected/excluded/missing records never count as reviewed labels.
Sample manifests preserve selection method, population, grouped unit and exclusions. Targeted discoveries cannot establish ordinary traffic prevalence without a justified sampling design.
Disputed and rejected labels remain versioned; label changes do not rewrite historical grader calibration. Private labels/fixtures are not shared by reusing their general procedure.

nodes.label: Evaluation failure definition
nodes.summary: A versioned, recognizable product defect learned from observations and explicit requirements; independent of a grader or application ticket.
rules: Definitions and evidence are versioned independently of judge implementation; criteria drift needs recorded reasons and new comparison/validation boundaries.

Human expertise from the research informs initial definitions; company/task modes may assign authorized people or agents and modular checks. No universal staffing minimum, human-only gate or benchmark threshold.
Failure discovery does not assign or execute a product fix. Direct engineering regression checks and ongoing optional quality review remain separate; no global eval gate blocks all shipping.

nodes.label: Acquisition opportunity
nodes.summary: A prospective purchase or contribution, with seller authority, offered scope and evaluation decisions separate from acquired ownership.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Permission to investigate or model does not authorize an offer or confer ownership.

nodes.label: Offered acquisition component
nodes.summary: An individually scoped offered copyright, income interest, administration mandate or excluded asset; a proposal does not create operative rights.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Accounting inference must not overwrite authorized legal interpretation.

nodes.label: Diligence requirement and finding
nodes.summary: A specific requested test or evidence item, including population, sampling, uncertainty and a reviewed disposition.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Seller claims remain claims until supported and reviewed by the appropriate owner.
Source evidence and acceptance must remain separate from design, current implementation and external completion.

nodes.label: Acquisition closing
nodes.summary: The exact approved/executed package, legal and economic dates, settlement, conditions and operational acceptance.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Signature, cash settlement and legal/operating completeness require separate evidence.

nodes.label: Business obligation
nodes.summary: A source-backed duty or conditional right with an obligated party, trigger, due window, required proof and acceptance; its business state is independent of task completion.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Model conventions are not contractual terms; identify reviewed agreement authority for each payment condition.
Economic benefit and legal ownership/control can be different during transition.
Expose protected pointers and status, not bank/tax identifiers or unrelated sensitive person fields.
A contractual duty is not evidence of performance; tax clauses are attributed historical terms, not current tax advice.
Source evidence and acceptance must remain separate from design, current implementation and external completion.

nodes.label: Company equity position
nodes.summary: A dated registered or asserted holding in a legal entity and class, separate from music copyright and from rights to acquire equity.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Separate investor subscription, company issuance, shareholder transfer, filing, escrow release and restricted use of funds; incomplete extraction cannot establish current ownership.

nodes.label: Equity issuance or transfer
nodes.summary: A primary issuance, secondary transfer or asset contribution with separate funding destination, conditions and ownership-registration evidence.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Contribution of an income stream does not transfer copyright; entity equity is distinct from catalog rights.
Historical exercise windows do not prove present authority; rights over securities or excluded songs are not ownership itself.

nodes.label: Company decision authority
nodes.summary: An attributed version of an entity decision rule: body, reserved action, thresholds, eligible constituencies and unresolved precedence. It grants no software permission.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Different board and shareholder rules may overlap; unresolved precedence and extraction gaps block automatic authorization.
Source evidence and acceptance must remain separate from design, current implementation and external completion.

nodes.label: Board meeting or written resolution
nodes.summary: The notice, eligible participants, exact decision materials, quorum evidence, resolution, signed minutes and follow-through of a company decision.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Decision participation, confidential information access and external speaking/signing authority differ.

nodes.label: Intercompany service engagement
nodes.summary: A company provides a defined service to another under a scoped agreement, with separate expense, staffing, delivery and reimbursement authority.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Shared department access is purpose-bound; service performance, expense approval and transaction authority are separate.

nodes.label: Financing facility or tranche
nodes.summary: A versioned financing arrangement and tranche with explicit indicative/executed state, lender terms, eligible collateral, draws and release evidence.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
A workbook rule or target closing date is not proof of an executed facility or lender permission.

nodes.label: Collateral pool membership
nodes.summary: A dated inclusion, exclusion or unresolved eligibility decision for a specific interest and facility pool version, retaining encumbrances and valuation basis.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Latest external valuation is not automatically complete for newly acquired catalogs.
Source evidence and acceptance must remain separate from design, current implementation and external completion.

nodes.label: Funding covenant assessment
nodes.summary: A dated test against the exact rule and pool version, including numerator, denominator, unknown population, waiver and cure evidence.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Allocated purchase price and DCF are different bases; unattributed All Other cannot imply low artist concentration.

nodes.label: Capital capacity and allocation
nodes.summary: One dated capital source, reservation or use with cash basis, reserves and obligations so acquisition funding and distributions do not double count the same money.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Avoid counting holdback or acquisition financing twice; model cash distribution policy separately from accounting profit.

nodes.label: Physical release configuration
nodes.summary: A stable SKU/configuration of a release with product-specific quantity, manufacturing, market and requirement evidence; configurations do not collapse into a release date.
rules: Acceptance requires exact source evidence and an authorized reviewer. Never infer ownership, permission or execution from this record existing.
An unknown value stays unknown; a missing receipt does not mean an action failed or succeeded. All example acceptance checks describe behavior, not executed tests.
Source evidence and acceptance must remain separate from design, current implementation and external completion.

nodes.label: Reusable ingestion adapter
nodes.summary: A versioned reader and provider/layout interpretation module, separate from source access and company accounting policy.
rules: logical design only: source discovery, parser success, financial acceptance and live behavior are separate.
Company/task settings and scoped evidence govern automation; reusable modules never inherit private source access.
Preserve original versions and ambiguity; no title-only identity, blanket source-rule adoption or silent double-count removal.

nodes.label: Statement component & source role
nodes.summary: A source-backed part of a statement or settlement package: detail, summary, ledger, derived output or reference, with its own scope and accounting role.
rules: logical design only: source discovery, parser success, financial acceptance and live behavior are separate.
Company/task settings and scoped evidence govern automation; reusable modules never inherit private source access.
Preserve original versions and ambiguity; no title-only identity, blanket source-rule adoption or silent double-count removal.

nodes.label: Selecting authoritative statements
nodes.summary: An immutable choice of qualified source components for one company/report basis and coverage revision; preserves replacement history without adding a second ledger.
rules: logical design only: source discovery, parser success, financial acceptance and live behavior are separate.
Company/task settings and scoped evidence govern automation; reusable modules never inherit private source access.
Preserve original versions and ambiguity; no title-only identity, blanket source-rule adoption or silent double-count removal.

nodes.label: External provider job
nodes.summary: A provider-owned asynchronous operation with native lifecycle, exact input identity, separately retained outputs and billing effects. It is not the company workflow run.
rules: Keep provider job identity/state separate from local workflow/task state and immutable input versions.
Only exact authorized action inputs may spend money or replace approved outputs.
Reconcile an uncertain submission before creating another job; preserve every attempt and unknown source guarantee.

nodes.label: Cross-provider catalog migration
nodes.summary: A versioned cross-provider cutover with selected products, file/identifier mappings, independent old/new destination outcomes and retained economic history. Provider workspace custody transfers remain separate.
rules: Freeze selected products, exact bytes, identifiers and cutover ordering independently of provider workspace custody.
Copyright interests, mandates and past financial records do not transfer merely because products move.
A successful batch submit or source takedown intent does not prove safe per-store cutover; resume only unresolved members.

nodes.label: Versioned media share grant
nodes.summary: An independently revocable media capability that controls listening, downloading, feedback and version selection without granting copyright or identity authority.
rules: Scope listening/download/comment/version permissions independently of ownership, project membership and consent.
A link following latest cannot authorize promotion of a later version from a review of an earlier mix.
A link view, play count or anonymous name does not identify a person or prove delivery acceptance.

nodes.label: Version-bound media annotation
nodes.summary: Raw comments, markers, ranges or lyric notes pinned to immutable media versions. Reviews and accepted changes are separate decisions.
rules: Pin every marker, comment or range to the immutable version it describes.
Store anonymous claimed names separately from verified authors; comments do not approve rights, metadata or creative promotion.
Keep the original annotation when listening to another mix; require alignment evidence before copying its time coordinates.

nodes.label: External platform playlist
nodes.summary: A platform-native programme/playlist identity with sourced curator, territory and metadata. It is independent of a business catalog, copyright interest or private audience.
rules: Preserve platform-native playlist identity, provider crosswalk, curator and storefront as separately sourced roles.
Membership, editorial classification and popularity confer no distribution, rights or roster authority.
Private queries/history remain private even when independently public playlist identity is reusable.

nodes.label: Dated playlist placement observation
nodes.summary: A sourced assertion that a track appeared at an order/position in a particular playlist and observation window. It is not owned catalog membership or proof of caused streams.
rules: A dated playlist occurrence is a measurement claim with source track namespace, window and position basis.
Observed placement and estimated playlist-attributed streams remain independent and non-causal.
Missing/uncomputed history404 is not an invalid native track ID or zero streams; preserve coverage and correction history.

nodes.label: Digital wallet profile
nodes.summary: Chain-address/account identity, custody and control separate from legal person, tenant, copyright and income entitlement
rules: Preserve source/network/resource identity separately from legal person, income entitlement, software tenancy and copyright.
Technical chain/control state requires exact separately authorized evidence; no source docs satisfy finality or legal-effect gates.
Token holder units and source payout sentinel0 never become copyright/equity percent or verified settled cash.

nodes.label: Tokenized income interest
nodes.summary: Token representation of a specific income interest; no corporate equity or copyright assignment inferred
rules: Preserve source/network/resource identity separately from legal person, income entitlement, software tenancy and copyright.
Technical chain/control state requires exact separately authorized evidence; no source docs satisfy finality or legal-effect gates.
Token holder units and source payout sentinel0 never become copyright/equity percent or verified settled cash.

nodes.label: Royalty rate rule & history
nodes.summary: Source-qualified versioned formula, term or eligibility rule; current applicable selection and historical knowledge kept separate.
rules: A rate rule is an authoritative scoped formula, term or eligibility policy; an effective payout is an observation, not a licence.
Choose by applicable right/use, service offering, territory, recipient chain, usage period, evidence authority and known-at cutoff. Missing dimensions or competing rules stay unresolved.

Future-effective, provisional, withdrawn or conflicting versions cannot silently replace an accepted applicable version. A private agreement can override a statutory default only with evidenced applicability.
Preserve immutable versions and correction ancestry. Current knowledge may restate historical calculations; as-known outputs retain their exact selected versions.
No rule grants ownership, access, payment approval or applicability merely from a matching provider name.

nodes.label: Reported & effective royalty rate
nodes.summary: Reported, earnings-derived or estimated rate with exact right, money, unit, coverage and source history.
rules: Keep source-declared unit rates, calculated effective rates and estimated benchmarks distinct. A public combined-rights average cannot be relabeled master-only or artist-net.
A calculated average is sum of compatible selected money divided by sum of compatible eligible units; preserve the exact decimal fraction and defer output rounding.
Never average row rates, duplicate summary/detail money or multiply earnings through multiple song/work matches. Preserve unmatched money in accounted totals.
Unknown units, zero denominator, suppressed or ineligible usage and missing currencies produce explicit coverage/exception states, never an invented zero payout.
Private-dependent rates and forecasts inherit their source scope. Public facts may compound independently, but private contracts or earnings do not become shared facts.

nodes.label: Reusable swarm mission
nodes.summary: Versioned company-goal module: domain rules, roles, strategies and evidence; distinct from each execution instance.
rules: Reusable mission definition is not a singleton agent, run, shared conversation or combined departmental task list.
A registered module does not grant source/tool access; trusted module registration is separate from sandboxing arbitrary code.
Domain evaluation may require external evidence; completed tasks and syntactically valid output do not prove the business goal.

nodes.label: Autonomous agent working group
nodes.summary: A scoped unit of exploration/ownership within one mission run; group strategy can adapt without changing truth or permission rules.
rules: Hierarchical ownership and selective lateral exchange may coexist; one model cannot be required to read all group messages.
Group and mission state/credentials/budgets/cancellation are scoped; shared quota exhaustion is an admission condition, not fabricated task failure.
Different role names or model agreement are not independent corroboration; record source ancestry and exact influences.

nodes.label: Targeted agent message
nodes.summary: Durable causal communication with exact evidence and recipients; transport notification is not accepted work or delegated authority.
rules: Persist intent/message and outbox transactionally, deduplicate inbox delivery, retain poison/failed/stale state; at-least-once unordered transport never implies exactly-once external effects.
A receiver rereads effective permissions and revision preconditions; original source facts and dissent survive bounded retrieval.
Accepted communication is not accepted truth, external action authorization, completed work or business success.

nodes.label: Release delivery configuration
nodes.summary: Revisioned release intent, destination overrides and immutable effective configurations; separate from legal rights and an executed delivery.
rules: Resolve only selected destination overrides; absent/null/empty/false must retain separate semantics.
Configuration, legal permission, QC, authorized submission, transport acceptance and verified availability are independent gates.
Changing effective commercial inputs invalidates the earlier package approval unless exact permitted scope remains satisfied.

nodes.label: Catalog custody transfer request
nodes.summary: Explicit sender/recipient acceptance workflow for administrative custody of selected catalog records; legal and financial effects stay separately qualified.
rules: Only a separately authorized recipient accepts; expiry, repeated acceptance and cross-tenant conflicts require explicit state guards.
ISRC/UPC and shared subject identity survive administrative custody change; rights, mandate, entitlements and historical financial access do not silently move.

nodes.label: Webhook subscription
nodes.summary: Durable provider callback registration with event filters, scoped destination, signing-key versions and independent delivery evidence.
rules: Provider acceptance of a callback registration is independent of delivered, authenticated and processed events.
Each signing secret version and retry attempt keeps a separate receipt; event filters cannot prove completeness of the provider event stream.

nodes.label: External provider event
nodes.summary: Untrusted incoming provider event preserved before verification, deduplication and authorized canonical state application; separate from change-event.
rules: An incoming provider event has no canonical aggregate_version until a separately authorized atomic commit emits change-event.
Signature validity proves source integrity, not rights, freshness, ordering, real destination effects or permission to apply state.
Retry attempts share stable event identity where available; ambiguous source IDs are quarantined rather than inventing exactly-once guarantees.

nodes.label: Service subscription
nodes.summary: Versioned provider plan, billing cycle, cancellation, grace and entitlement lifecycle; separate from action metering and music royalties.
rules: Payment verification may mutate activation even when exposed as GET; method/tool naming is not an authority classification.
A successful return or charge.success callback is source evidence; independently qualify settled funds and entitlement activation.
402 release allowance/invoice grace and 403 video entitlement failures do not assert missing rights or revoke unrelated domain access.

nodes.label: Rights enforcement case
nodes.summary: Reported disputed use, Content ID policy or removal request with reviewed authority, exact notice and independently observed outcome.
rules: Reported ownership, operational platform access, reviewed enforcement authority, submitted notice and observed remedy are distinct.
Do not automate legal claims from an ISRC match, name match, provider asset ID or provider case flag alone.

nodes.label: Media upload intent
nodes.summary: Expiring authorized upload capability and expected object conditions, followed by independent byte, integrity and media validation before asset acceptance.
rules: No accepted asset/version is manufactured from a future CDN URL or presigned object key.
Verify retained bytes/hash, technical profile and subject association separately from transport acknowledgment and QC approval.

nodes.label: Release package component
nodes.summary: An exact role/slot-to-asset-version relationship inside one authored delivery package revision, separate from an observed provider track slot.
rules: Package component edits produce a new package revision and require new action approval; old approval remains historical.
The manifest and asset_version must identify the same bytes/version; each track master belongs to an explicit release slot.
Completeness depends on the selected partner profile; no fixed worldwide master/artwork requirements are invented.

nodes.label: Statement row identity decision
nodes.summary: A versioned decision connecting a reported statement row to recording/composition candidates without turning fuzzy matching into accepted rights or payable income.
rules: Accepted matching does not determine rights shares, income beneficiary, tax, payable amount or cash received.
All candidate identities and supporting evidence retain their versions; corrections supersede decisions without rewriting the original source row.
Ambiguous identity remains a candidate/conflict; no title-only automatic acceptance.
Until a separate allocation contract is adopted, accepted requires exactly one candidate and a review of this claim/evidence version. Multi-asset rows remain unresolved, never assigned arbitrarily.

nodes.label: Statement control reconciliation
nodes.summary: A bounded reconciliation of reported totals and normalized rows by exact statement version, currency and basis, distinct from rights calculations and bank/cash settlement.
rules: Never add different currencies or unlike amount bases; FX conversion requires separately evidenced date/rate/source and its own control.
Missing control totals, omitted rows or unknown currency cannot produce matched. Keep parse failures and excluded-row counts explicit.
Negative corrections are legitimate source values; retain sign and original/correction semantics instead of clamping to zero.
Rounding tolerance must name scale/method/threshold and authority; do not silently force totals to agree.

nodes.label: Approval before execution
nodes.summary: intent binds final bytes/lineage, actor/owner, action, recipient/destination, validity, mandate and spend to one approval. Dispatch rechecks authority; unknown outcomes reconcile before retry.

nodes.label: Public knowledge & source history
nodes.summary: independent source eligibility/terms/public lineage allows public facts to compound while requests/private-derived results stay private, without customer sharing prerequisites.

nodes.label: Agent permissions & limits
nodes.summary: non-secret connection references bind actor/client/run/owner/resource/purpose/action, destination and limits. Parent revocation invalidates descendants/resume; output/egress denial needs separate evidence.
